# UICorner

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UICorner")`

Rounds the corners of its parent. It changes only how the parent is drawn: layout and hit testing still use the full rectangle.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CornerRadius` | `UDim` | `UDim.new(0, 8)` | read/write | The radius of the corners. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's shorter side, so `UDim.new(0.5, 0)` gives a pill shape at any size. |
